Fit the model with NumPy (column of ones, then `age`, `bmi`, `children`, `male`, `smoke`), predict `charges_hat`, and add a column `excess_charges = charges - charges_hat`.

problems.solution:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("insurance.csv")
df["male"] = np.where(df.sex == "male", 1, 0)
df["smoke"] = np.where(df.smoker == "yes", 1, 0)

X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(df)), df[features].to_numpy()])

df["excess_charges"] = df["charges"] - df["charges_hat"]
